capture.title: Smoke baseline
capture.expectation: A stable third-person flat-world view shows the complete local player before the local skin is applied. The UUID-selected vanilla default skin is intact; modern defaults such as Noor with a red top and green trousers are valid and must not be mistaken for a custom skin.

capture.title: Smoke local skin
capture.expectation: A normal first-person world view whose lower-right player arm wears the custom skin's dark charcoal-and-gray plaid sleeve with a brown hand.

capture.title: Propagation subject baseline
capture.expectation: A stable third-person flat-world view shows the complete subject with the intact UUID-selected vanilla default skin. Modern defaults such as Noor with a red top and green trousers are valid and must not be mistaken for a custom skin.

capture.title: Propagation subject applied
capture.expectation: The subject remains in first person while the lower-right player arm wears the custom skin's dark charcoal-and-gray plaid sleeve with a brown hand.

capture.title: Propagation observer baseline
capture.expectation: A stable third-person world view shows the complete observer with the intact UUID-selected vanilla default skin. Modern defaults such as Makena with dark hair and a yellow or orange top are valid. The remote subject is deliberately held behind the camera and must not be visible before the later inspection checkpoint.

capture.title: Propagation observed remotely
capture.expectation: The observer sees Alice wearing the custom skin with brown hair, a dark charcoal-and-gray plaid jacket and blue trousers, plus the orange or green face of a deep-blue cape.

capture.title: Live subject baseline
capture.expectation: A stable third-person flat-world view shows the complete subject with the intact UUID-selected vanilla default skin. Modern defaults such as Noor with a red top and green trousers are valid and must not be mistaken for a custom skin.

capture.title: Live subject applied
capture.expectation: The subject's first-person view includes the newly applied custom skin on the lower-right player arm: a dark charcoal-and-gray plaid sleeve with a brown hand.

capture.title: Live observer baseline
capture.expectation: A stable third-person world view shows the complete observer with the intact UUID-selected vanilla default skin after joining. Modern defaults such as Makena with dark hair and a yellow or orange top are valid; the remote subject must remain outside this baseline frame.

capture.title: Live observer before
capture.expectation: The observer sees the complete Alice model with her intact UUID-selected vanilla default skin and no cape before the live change. Noor's dark hair, red top, green trousers and salmon hands are valid vanilla colours, not evidence of a custom skin.

capture.title: Live observer after
capture.expectation: The observer sees the same Alice changed to the custom skin with brown hair, a dark charcoal-and-gray plaid jacket and blue trousers, plus a custom orange or green cape.

capture.title: Full-suite baseline
capture.expectation: A centered complete player model in a stable third-person flat daytime world view has the intact UUID-selected vanilla default skin before Quick Skin applies a custom appearance. Modern defaults such as Noor with a red top and green trousers are valid and must not be mistaken for a custom skin.

capture.title: Local skin applied
capture.expectation: The centered third-person player wears the custom skin: brown hair, a dark charcoal-and-gray plaid jacket and blue trousers.

capture.title: Skin menu
capture.expectation: The Quick Skin player-skin menu is open with readable catalog labels and drop-zone instructions over a dark, subtly starred background; there is no bright blur, radial wash or other background-compositing artifact.

capture.title: External skin imported
capture.expectation: The skin menu shows the externally dropped skin as an available catalog entry without a broken texture.

capture.title: Slim model
capture.expectation: A close, stable rear view clearly shows the custom dark charcoal-and-gray plaid jacket and blue trousers on slim Alex geometry, with visibly narrow 3-pixel-wide arms.

capture.title: Classic model
capture.expectation: A close, stable rear view clearly shows the custom dark charcoal-and-gray plaid jacket and blue trousers on classic Steve geometry, with visibly wider 4-pixel-wide arms.

capture.title: Cape menu
capture.expectation: The Quick Skin cape menu is open with a readable title and drop-zone instructions alongside its custom panels and controls.

capture.title: Bundled cape applied
capture.expectation: The player is seen from behind wearing the bundled orange or gold cape over the custom skin.

capture.title: Cape editor
capture.expectation: The Quick Skin cape-adjustment editor is open with a readable title and drag/zoom instructions alongside its cape image, grid and editing controls.

capture.title: Cape preview A
capture.expectation: The cape editor previews the first selected cape while keeping the currently worn cape state distinct.

capture.title: Cape preview B
capture.expectation: The cape editor visibly previews the second selected cape, different from preview A.

capture.title: Cape transparency enabled
capture.expectation: The cape editor displays the transparent form of the test cape with the opaque toggle disabled.

capture.title: Cape forced opaque
capture.expectation: The cape editor displays the opaque form of the test cape with the opaque toggle enabled.

capture.title: Cape zoomed out
capture.expectation: The cape editor preview shows the cape at the low zoom position.

capture.title: Cape zoomed in
capture.expectation: The cape editor preview shows a visibly different crop at the high zoom position.

capture.title: Bundled BMO cape
capture.expectation: The player is seen from behind wearing the bundled BMO cape; this is the unedited visual reference for the adjusted BMO cape capture.

capture.title: Bundled BMO elytra
capture.expectation: The crouching player wears elytra textured directly by the bundled BMO atlas; the pose must visibly separate both wings, and this is the unedited visual reference for the adjusted BMO elytra capture.

capture.title: Black-padded BMO source
capture.expectation: At the editor's 100% reset zoom, Source: 128x64 and Output: 64x32 are both visible: the output selector describes the final atlas, not the imported source. The complete BMO atlas is centred at half size inside that double-sized source, with broad opaque-black padding on all four sides and a checkerboard visible only through transparent source pixels; at this before-crop checkpoint it is intentionally not aligned to the coloured UV guides yet.

capture.title: Black-padded BMO aligned
capture.expectation: At 200% zoom, the complete 64x32 BMO atlas fills the crop: the Front, Cape Back and tapered Elytra art align with their coloured guides and the previews are intact. Narrow teal strips between or beside those three highlighted faces are expected auxiliary side, top and bottom UV faces from the same BMO atlas, not leaked padding.

capture.title: Adjusted BMO cape
capture.expectation: The player wears the BMO cape saved through the editor, and it looks the same as the bundled BMO cape reference without black padding leaking into the visible surface.

capture.title: Adjusted BMO elytra
capture.expectation: The crouching player wears elytra from the BMO cape saved through the editor; the pose must visibly separate both wings, which look the same as the bundled BMO elytra reference without broken UV placement.

capture.title: Vanilla elytra after cape removal
capture.expectation: After the active BMO cape is removed through the cape menu, the same crouching player still wears two clearly separated elytra wings, now using Minecraft's ordinary gray-brown vanilla elytra texture. No cyan BMO artwork, custom cape texture, flat cape panel or missing wing is visible.

capture.title: Animated cape frame A
capture.expectation: The player wears a real dark animated cape whose light face contains a complete red vertical motif fully inside the cape surface; it is not clipped, blank, black or garbled.

capture.title: Animated cape frame B
capture.expectation: A later frozen frame of the same dark cape is visible; the complete motif has changed from red to blue and moved horizontally while remaining fully inside the cape surface.

capture.title: HD cape preserved
capture.expectation: The player wears a crisp custom HD cape with a bright magenta front panel and teal base or trim.

capture.title: Elytra hides cape
capture.expectation: The centered player has angled elytra wings and no flat rectangular cape hanging behind the main body.

capture.title: Editor preview ignores equipped elytra
capture.expectation: The cape editor continues to render its cape preview even while the player has an elytra equipped.

capture.title: Settings screen
capture.expectation: The Quick Skin settings screen is open with a readable Open Skin Menu label, toggles and checkboxes.

capture.title: Rename dialog
capture.expectation: A compact rename dialog is open with a text input and confirmation control.

capture.title: Delete confirmation
capture.expectation: A compact delete-confirmation dialog is open with cancel and delete controls.

capture.title: HUD player preview
capture.expectation: An in-world view includes a small, distinct player-preview thumbnail in a lower corner.

capture.title: Title-screen layer order
capture.expectation: On the Minecraft title screen, the enlarged 3D player preview occludes the yellow splash text instead of the text crossing the model.
